biology.microorganisms-explain.0001.all: respiration of microorganisms releases heat; cold water absorbs/removes heat, keeping temperature at optimum; prevents enzymes denaturing / microorganisms dying so yield maximised

biology.microorganisms-explain-multi.000.b: bacteria may become resistant to antibiotics; antibiotics enter water/environment killing useful bacteria; may enter food chain/humans; cost

biology.microorganisms-ext.0004.all: Plan: water quality (O2, waste removal, temp); separate by size to prevent intraspecific predation; nets exclude predators/interspecific; disease control antibiotics/pesticides/low stocking density; high-protein food, controlled frequency; selective breeding for fast growth
